inputs.source:
codeFacts:
  mode: "embedded"
  provider: "codegraph"
  required: true
content:
  decisions: ".archcontext/decisions"
  generated: ".archcontext/generated"
  policies: ".archcontext/policies"
  practices: ".archcontext/practices"
  projections: ".archcontext/projections"
generated:
  commitToGit: true
  formats:
    - "markdown"
    - "mermaid"
model:
  layout: "split"
  root: ".archcontext/model"
privacy:
  cloudContentUpload: "deny"
  localTunnel:
    includeSourceByDefault: false
    maxResultBytes: 8192
product:
  governanceLevel: "auto"
  id: "product.repo-harness"
  name: "repo-harness"
review:
  failOn:
    - "invalid-schema"
    - "prohibited-dependency"
    - "unjustified-compatibility"
    - "stale-context"
    - "incomplete-intervention"
runtime:
  checkpoint:
    changedFileThreshold: 20
    requiredBeforeComplete: true
  contextBudgetBytes: 12288

schemaVersion: archcontext.flow/v1
id: flow.acceptance-review.primary
capabilityId: capability.verification.acceptance-review
name: Run one generic acceptance review round
applicability: required
participants:
  - id: capability
    nodeId: capability.verification.acceptance-review
  - id: round
    nodeId: component.acceptance-review.primary
  - id: circuit-breaker
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.hook-adapters
steps:
  - id: start-round
    from: capability
    to: round
    label: The review command starts one round for the contract and verification evidence
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.acceptance-review.primary
      sourceSymbol: buildReviewCommand
      sinkId: sink.acceptance-review.primary
  - id: admit-session
    from: capability
    to: circuit-breaker
    label: Admit at most one persistent semantic review session per work package
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.acceptance-review.primary
      sourceSymbol: buildReviewCommand
      sinkId: sink.acceptance-review.circuit-admission
  - id: compose-packet
    from: capability
    to: round
    label: Compose and save the complete review packet before the reviewer starts
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.acceptance-review.round
      sourceSymbol: runReviewRound
      sinkId: sink.acceptance-review.packet
outcomes:
  - id: success
    kind: success
    label: Reviewer output is valid
    steps:
      - id: record-receipt
        from: capability
        to: round
        label: Record the AcceptanceReceipt with the PASS or FAIL disposition
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.acceptance-review.round
          sourceSymbol: runReviewRound
          sinkId: sink.acceptance-review.record-receipt
    terminal:
      participant: capability
      label: Return accepted or rejected with the receipt
  - id: error
    kind: error
    label: Reviewer output is malformed or inconsistent
    steps:
      - id: reject-output
        from: capability
        to: round
        label: Reject output that breaks the closed schema or leaves a prior finding unaddressed
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.acceptance-review.round
          sourceSymbol: runReviewRound
          sinkId: sink.acceptance-review.validate-output
    terminal:
      participant: capability
      label: Fail the round without a receipt

id: flow.agent-runtime-effects.lifecycle
capabilityId: capability.runtime-harness.agent-runtime-effects
name: Admit and reconcile one bound Agent runtime effect
applicability: required
participants:
  - id: effect-journal
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.agent-runtime-effects
  - id: binding-authority
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.engineer-bindings
  - id: message-authority
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.engineer-messages
  - id: effect-schema
    nodeId: component.agent-runtime-effects.journal
steps:
  - id: resolve-persisted-input
    from: effect-journal
    to: message-authority
    label: Read the exact persisted Module or Task message and its current delivery fact before action admission
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.agent-runtime-effects.prepare
      sourceSymbol: moduleReference
      sinkId: sink.agent-runtime-effects.persisted-message
  - id: revalidate-binding
    from: effect-journal
    to: binding-authority
    label: Revalidate Binding generation, Host, endpoint and contract revision
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.agent-runtime-effects.prepare
      sourceSymbol: currentBinding
      sinkId: sink.agent-runtime-effects.current-binding
outcomes:
  - id: success
    kind: success
    label: One immutable intent admits at most one Host action and exact receipt evidence closes the observation chain
    steps:
      - id: project-positive-delivery
        from: effect-journal
        to: message-authority

        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.agent-runtime-effects.observe
          sourceSymbol: receiptEvidence
          sinkId: sink.agent-runtime-effects.receipt-evidence
    terminal:

      label: Return terminal effect current and no further Host action
  - id: reconcile
    kind: error
    label: Lost acknowledgement or ambiguous Host facts remain reconciliation_required without retry
    steps:

        from: effect-journal
        to: effect-schema
        label: Persist reconciliation_required in the immutable effect chain while leaving the authoritative receipt unchanged

          entrypointId: entrypoint.agent-runtime-effects.observe
          sourceSymbol: observeAgentRuntimeEffect
          sinkId: sink.agent-runtime-effects.reconciliation-observation
    terminal:

id: flow.bound-task-freezes.inspect-freeze
capabilityId: capability.runtime-harness.bound-task-freezes
name: Inspect and freeze one bound task without takeover
applicability: required
participants:
  - id: bound-task-freezes
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.bound-task-freezes
  - id: engineer-bindings
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.engineer-bindings
  - id: freeze-store
    nodeId: component.bound-task-freezes.primary
steps:
  - id: read-bound-authority
    from: bound-task-freezes
    to: engineer-bindings
    label: Resolve one current Binding and one exact live ClaimActorReceipt fenced to the bound Lease and persisted WorkEnvelope
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.bound-task-freezes.inspect
      sourceSymbol: readCurrentTaskFreezeBinding
      sinkId: sink.bound-task-freezes.binding-current
  - id: build-receipt
    from: bound-task-freezes
    to: freeze-store
    label: Double-read exact Git and control-plane observations before building one canonical TaskFreezeReceipt
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.bound-task-freezes.inspect
      sourceSymbol: inspectBoundTaskLocked
      sinkId: sink.bound-task-freezes.receipt-schema
outcomes:
  - id: frozen
    kind: success
    label: Stable observations persist one immutable receipt with closed Human choices
    steps:
      - id: persist-freeze
        from: bound-task-freezes
        to: freeze-store
        label: Publish content-addressed receipt bytes without Claim, Lease or Binding mutation
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.bound-task-freezes.persist
          sourceSymbol: inspectBoundTaskLocked
          sinkId: sink.bound-task-freezes.immutable-store
    terminal:
      participant: bound-task-freezes
      label: Return clean-release evidence or freeze-required reasons; never elect a successor
  - id: refused
    kind: error
    label: Changed or stale state and active-Claim rotation fail closed
    steps:
      - id: refuse-rotation
        from: bound-task-freezes
        to: engineer-bindings
        label: Refuse Binding replace or retire until the live Claim follows its explicit release path
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.bound-task-freezes.rotation-refusal
          sourceSymbol: assertNoLiveClaimForBindingRotation
          sinkId: sink.bound-task-freezes.live-claim
      - id: reject-stale
        from: bound-task-freezes
        to: freeze-store
        label: Compare every receipt fence with a fresh double-read observation and reject any change
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.bound-task-freezes.verify
          sourceSymbol: verifyTaskFreeze
          sinkId: sink.bound-task-freezes.stale-compare
    terminal:
      participant: bound-task-freezes
      label: Preserve the existing Claim and worktree topology; perform no takeover or implicit release

schemaVersion: archcontext.flow/v1
id: flow.collaboration.bounded-agent-surface
capabilityId: capability.runtime-harness.collaboration
name: Serve one bounded Module Engineer surface over the collaboration substrate and fence the dispatch that consumes it
applicability: required
participants:
  - id: collaboration
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.collaboration
  - id: collaboration-store
    nodeId: component.collaboration.primary
  - id: engineer-mcp
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.mcp-sidecar
  - id: delegated-runs
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.delegated-runs
  - id: scheduling-authority
    nodeId: capability.runtime-harness.engineer-scheduling
  - id: delegated-run-store
    nodeId: component.delegated-runs.primary
steps:
  - id: authenticate-the-caller
    from: collaboration
    to: scheduling-authority
    label: Resolve the authenticated principal before collection and on each offer read
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.agent-surface-offers
      sourceSymbol: resolveSurfacePrincipal
      sinkId: sink.collaboration.surface-principal
  - id: ask-the-scheduling-plane
    from: collaboration
    to: scheduling-authority
    label: Ask the scheduling plane what this exact authenticated principal could pick up, so an empty offer list means the plane answered rather than that nobody asked
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.agent-surface-offers
      sourceSymbol: collect
      sinkId: sink.collaboration.surface-offer-authority
outcomes:
  - id: served
    kind: success
    label: A Module Engineer reads the exchange and publishes bounded records whose author the Host derived, with every payload marked untrusted
    steps:
      - id: collect-for-the-caller
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Collect the same double-read exchange the Host reads, so the surface adds no cache and no second answer that could disagree with snapshot_sha256
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.agent-surface-read
          sourceSymbol: collect
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.surface-exchange-collect
      - id: read-through-the-command
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Serve the command family from the shared surface, so the CLI restates none of the actor, destination or marking rules
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.command-family
          sourceSymbol: exchangeAction
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.command-exchange
      - id: read-through-the-tool
        from: engineer-mcp
        to: collaboration
        label: Serve the same surface to the closed Engineer tool inventory, which carries no arbitrary write, generic shell, acquire, publication, acceptance or merge tool
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.mcp-sidecar.collaboration-tools
          sourceSymbol: callCollaborationTool
          sinkId: sink.mcp-sidecar.collaboration-exchange
      - id: publish-with-a-derived-author
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Publish through the store that derives the author from the authorization, with no parameter anywhere that would accept a caller-declared actor
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.agent-surface-publish
          sourceSymbol: collaborationSignalPost
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.surface-signal-publish
      - id: post-through-the-command
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Reject an undeclared key on the wire before publishing, so an identity claim is refused with the field named rather than silently dropped
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.command-family
          sourceSymbol: postAction
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.command-signal-post
      - id: adopt-non-exclusively
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Record adoption as an identity statement that grants no Task, Claim or Lease, so distinct adopters never exclude one another
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.agent-surface-publish
          sourceSymbol: collaborationHandoffAdopt
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.surface-handoff-adopt
    terminal:
      participant: collaboration
      label: Return the payload with its mode and its untrusted-coordination marking; no Task, Lease, Publication or Acceptance byte moved
  - id: gated
    kind: error
    label: A packet build is refused while collaboration.mode is off, and reads keep answering so the flag stays observable
    steps:
      - id: gate-the-build
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Apply the mutation gate at the first boundary a caller can trigger a packet write from, since C6 built delivery as a Host step inside an already-gated round
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.agent-surface-packet
          sourceSymbol: collaborationPacketBuild
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.surface-mutation-gate
      - id: deliver-the-rendering
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Return C6's rendering verbatim with its untrusted markers intact, rather than re-emitting them from a second producer
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.agent-surface-packet
          sourceSymbol: collaborationPacketBuild
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.surface-context-delivery
    terminal:
      participant: collaboration
      label: Surface the typed refusal with the flag's own reason; a repository that has not opted in cannot grow collaboration state through this surface
  - id: fenced
    kind: error
    label: A dispatch carrying injected coordination context that no binding accounts for is refused before the host action
    steps:
      - id: decide-the-intent
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Decide from Host-owned state whether this dispatch is a collaboration dispatch, treating a persisted binding and an untrusted marker in the goal as equally sufficient
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.dispatch-guard
          sourceSymbol: fenceCollaborationDispatch
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.dispatch-intent
      - id: check-the-binding
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Re-run the whole binding check against the live run for a collaboration dispatch, and let a delegation-only run through untouched
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.dispatch-guard
          sourceSymbol: fenceCollaborationDispatch
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.dispatch-binding-assert
      - id: reach-the-host-action
        from: delegated-runs
        to: delegated-run-store
        label: Call the one exported dispatch from the command adapter, which carries no collaboration pre-step of its own and no second opinion about which runs need a binding
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.delegated-runs.dispatch-command
          sourceSymbol: dispatchDelegatedRunCommand
          sinkId: sink.delegated-runs.dispatch-host-action
      - id: fence-before-the-host-action
        from: delegated-runs
        to: collaboration
        label: Run the fence as the first statement under the dispatch lock, so no caller reaches the host action by forgetting a pre-step and the fence decides on the same locked view the host action is taken from
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.delegated-runs.dispatch-effect
          sourceSymbol: dispatchDelegatedRun
          sinkId: sink.delegated-runs.collaboration-dispatch-fence
    terminal:
      participant: delegated-runs
      label: Surface the typed refusal naming the one fact that failed; injected context that no record accounts for cannot reach a Worker

          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.exchange-offer-projection

          sinkId: sink.collaboration.existing-offer-authority

        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Select within budget from that exact collection, binding the source snapshot, estimator version, truncation evidence and canonical render digest
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.context-delivery
          sourceSymbol: deliverCollaborationContext
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.context-packet-build
      - id: compose-the-goal
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Append the rendering inside the untrusted coordination markers, reversibly, so the block embedded in the goal can be split back out and compared

          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.context-delivery

        from: collaboration

      - id: prove-the-context
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store

          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.execution-context-proof
          sourceSymbol: proveExecutionContexts

          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.succession
          sourceSymbol: resolveBoundTaskSuccession

      - id: rederive-and-compare
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Re-derive the whole branch from the receipt and compare canonical bytes, so a resolvable receipt describing a different Claim is caught too
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.succession

          sinkId: sink.collaboration.freeze-derived-context

        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Publish the succession handoff through the ordinary handoff store, carrying knowledge and never a Claim or a Lease
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.succession-publish
          sourceSymbol: publishBoundTaskSuccessionHandoff
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.succession-handoff-publish
    terminal:
      participant: collaboration

  - id: dispatch-refused
    kind: error
    label: A collaboration-mode run whose binding is missing, dangling, or describes a different goal is refused before it dispatches
    steps:
      - id: read-the-binding
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Read the persisted binding for this dispatch, treating its absence as a refusal rather than as permission
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.dispatch-fence
          sourceSymbol: assertCollaborationDispatchBinding
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.persisted-binding-read
      - id: check-the-binding
        from: collaboration
        to: collaboration-store
        label: Run the same pure check the recorder ran, against the live intent, execution packet and the goal actually being dispatched
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.dispatch-fence
          sourceSymbol: assertCollaborationDispatchBinding
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.binding-fence-check

id: flow.collaboration.delegated-contribution
capabilityId: capability.runtime-harness.collaboration
name: Admit a same-capability read-only participant and make exactly one of its contributions visible
applicability: required
participants:

    from: collaboration
    to: engineer-bindings
    label: Resolve the parent Module Engineer Profile from the parent claim so allowed_roles and max_parallel_readers are the values this admission decides against
    evidence:
      entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.admission-bridge
      sourceSymbol: admitCollaborationDelegation
      sinkId: sink.collaboration.parent-delegation-policy
outcomes:
  - id: admitted
    kind: success
    label: A participant under the limit is admitted through the unchanged read-only admission, and its seat exists before the counting lock is released
    steps:
      - id: require-tracked-role
        from: collaboration
        to: delegated-runs
        label: Load the tracked read-only Role Profile, because an open logical_role string is not authorization
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.admission-bridge
          sourceSymbol: admitCollaborationDelegation
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.tracked-role-profile
      - id: forward-to-existing-admission

        label: Forward the caller's admission input verbatim, leaving the existing admission semantics untouched

          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.admission-window

          sinkId: sink.collaboration.existing-admission
      - id: create-the-seat
        from: collaboration
        to: delegated-runs
        label: Create the run intent inside the same critical section that counted for the seat, so the granted seat is never invisible to the next request
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.admission-window
          sourceSymbol: admitInsideWindow
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.seat-creation
    terminal:
      participant: delegated-runs

          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.contribution-collect

          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.contribution-publish
          sourceSymbol: publishContribution
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.contribution-candidate
      - id: publish-commit
        from: collaboration
        to: record-store
        label: Publish the contribution commit last, as the sole visibility boundary over the candidates already on disk
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.contribution-publish
          sourceSymbol: publishContribution
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.contribution-commit
      - id: single-worker-result
        from: collaboration
        to: delegated-runs
        label: Construct the one WorkerResult for this run, carrying the commit as an evidence reference and refusing a second result with different bytes
        evidence:
          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.contribution-publish

          sinkId: sink.collaboration.single-worker-result

          entrypointId: entrypoint.collaboration.contribution-visibility
          sourceSymbol: listContributedSignalIds
          sinkId: sink.collaboration.committed-only

          sinkId: sink.collaboration.draft-schema

schemaVersion: archcontext.node/v2
id: capability.runtime-harness.collaboration
kind: capability
name: Collaboration Substrate
status: active
summary: Publishes append-only coordination signals, work-state handoffs, non-exclusive adoption receipts and delegated-Worker contribution commits over one shared create-once store substrate, enforces the parent Engineer's delegation policy at admission time as a pre-step to the existing read-only delegation, and reads that substrate back into one collaborative Work Exchange snapshot and one bounded context packet whose delivery into a delegated run is fenced by a required run-context binding, with Host-derived identity and recorded time and zero Task, Lease, Publication or Acceptance authority.
responsibilities:
  - Own the shared collaboration mechanics frozen for later rows, namely the actor union, revision-bound scope refs, the reused WorkerResult evidence-ref shape, deterministic record identity and the recorded-time source.
  - Validate CoordinationSignalV1 against an exact key set and content-address it, closing the transport without closing any collaboration vocabulary.
  - Derive the publishing actor from the authenticated Engineer principal and refuse any caller-declared identity.
  - Keep recorded time stable across retries by sampling only on the branch that creates a record and rebuilding a republish from the persisted value.
  - Persist each signal as one immutable content-checked file under a per-thread lock, with an lstat ancestor walk, explicit idempotency conflict and no healthy-empty fallback.
  - Restrict revision to supersede inside one actor lineage and require every reply, source and supersede reference to already resolve in the same repository.
  - Gate every mutation on collaboration.mode, which defaults to off, and perform no write to any delivery-plane store.
  - Own one durable create-once publish protocol and one server-side actor derivation as shared substrate, so each record family is a schema plus a shard name rather than a third copy of the crash-safety rules.
  - Validate WorkStateHandoffV1 with its attempted paths, dead ends, key findings and next actions present, and its execution context complete on exactly one branch of the discriminated union.
  - Record handoff adoption as non-exclusive by identity, keying each receipt on the handoff digest, the adopter actor digest and the context packet digest, so distinct adopters never exclude one another and grant no Task or Lease.
  - Turn the parent Module Engineer Profile's allowed_roles and max_parallel_readers into runtime constraints in a pre-step that leaves the existing read-only admission semantics untouched, counting active readers per parent claim and round index and creating the seat inside the same critical section that counted for it.
  - Fail the admission window closed whenever a reader's state cannot be established, its immutable records do not join, or it is awaiting reconciliation, so a seat is never inferred free.
  - Derive a delegated Worker's identity from the immutable WorkerRunRef and admission receipt rather than from anything the Worker produced, so a contribution can never name its own author.
  - Parse one run's contribution draft only from the exact stdout bytes the Host persisted for that run, through a versioned provider-output adapter, and refuse a caller-supplied draft by having no parameter that accepts one.
  - Derive every contributed signal and handoff identity from the WorkerRunRef and the entry index and every commit identity from the run reference alone, so a retried collection converges instead of appending duplicates.
  - Publish candidates immutably first and one contribution commit last as the sole visibility boundary, so a projection reads only committed contributions and an interrupted transaction leaves nothing partially visible.
  - Treat an unusable Worker output as a typed rejection that still persists the ordinary WorkerResult, never as a synthesised empty contribution or an appearance of success.
  - Separate knowledge succession from execution authority by deriving a bound_task execution context from the persisted TaskFreeze receipt on publish and re-deriving and comparing it on read, and by granting a successor a write path only through the existing release, takeover and acquire lifecycle.
  - Read collaboration.mode and every mutable collaboration record source twice inside one overlapping collection window, fail closed when mode is unreadable, and derive snapshot_consistency from what the two reads observed, since the store reader is the only layer that can tell a torn read from a still one.
  - Fail the collection closed when the signal set itself is unreadable, and mark the snapshot degraded when an additive source is, so a partial view is never served as a complete one.
  - Project existing EngineerOfferV1 records and their offer_revision verbatim into the Work Exchange snapshot, reinterpreting neither readiness nor revision.
  - Withhold any bound_task execution context whose read-time proof does not hold, and count the omission, rather than publishing an unproven Claim beside a flag.
  - Build the bounded context packet only from a stable collection, bind its source snapshot, estimator version, truncation evidence and canonical render digest, and compose the rendering into the delegated run's goal inside the untrusted coordination markers.
  - Record which collaboration packet and rendering entered which run as an additive run-context binding that bumps no delegation protocol, and refuse dispatch when that binding is missing, dangling, or describes a goal other than the one being dispatched.
  - Decide whether one dispatch is a collaboration dispatch from Host-owned state alone, treating a persisted binding or an untrusted coordination marker in the envelope goal as equally sufficient, so a run that carries injected context but never recorded a binding cannot skip the fence by omitting the record the fence checks.
  - Serve one bounded Module Engineer surface for both the command family and the MCP tool set, exposing no arbitrary file write, generic shell, task acquire or release, publication, acceptance or merge verb.
  - Accept no actor, publish destination or recorded time from a caller on that surface, refusing an undeclared key at the boundary rather than dropping it, so an identity claim has nowhere to land.
  - Serve collaboration reads while collaboration.mode is off and report the mode on every payload, while every mutation fails closed, so the flag stays observable through the surface an operator would use to observe it.
  - Mark every payload that carries agent-authored text as untrusted coordination context, and pass the canonical untrusted rendering through verbatim rather than re-emitting its markers from a second producer.

expected.name: Collaboration Substrate
expected.summary: Publishes append-only coordination signals, work-state handoffs, non-exclusive adoption receipts and delegated-Worker contribution commits over one shared create-once store substrate, enforces the parent Engineer's delegation policy at admission time as a pre-step to the existing read-only delegation, and reads that substrate back into one collaborative Work Exchange snapshot and one bounded context packet whose delivery into a delegated run is fenced by a required run-context binding, with Host-derived identity and recorded time and zero Task, Lease, Publication or Acceptance authority.
responsibilities: Own the shared collaboration mechanics frozen for later rows, namely the actor union, revision-bound scope refs, the reused WorkerResult evidence-ref shape, deterministic record identity and the recorded-time source.
Validate CoordinationSignalV1 against an exact key set and content-address it, closing the transport without closing any collaboration vocabulary.
Derive the publishing actor from the authenticated Engineer principal and refuse any caller-declared identity.
Keep recorded time stable across retries by sampling only on the branch that creates a record and rebuilding a republish from the persisted value.
Persist each signal as one immutable content-checked file under a per-thread lock, with an lstat ancestor walk, explicit idempotency conflict and no healthy-empty fallback.
Restrict revision to supersede inside one actor lineage and require every reply, source and supersede reference to already resolve in the same repository.
Gate every mutation on collaboration.mode, which defaults to off, and perform no write to any delivery-plane store.

Own one durable create-once publish protocol and one server-side actor derivation as shared substrate, so each record family is a schema plus a shard name rather than a third copy of the crash-safety rules.
Validate WorkStateHandoffV1 with its attempted paths, dead ends, key findings and next actions present, and its execution context complete on exactly one branch of the discriminated union.

Record handoff adoption as non-exclusive by identity, keying each receipt on the handoff digest, the adopter actor digest and the context packet digest, so distinct adopters never exclude one another and grant no Task or Lease.

Turn the parent Module Engineer Profile's allowed_roles and max_parallel_readers into runtime constraints in a pre-step that leaves the existing read-only admission semantics untouched, counting active readers per parent claim and round index and creating the seat inside the same critical section that counted for it.
Fail the admission window closed whenever a reader's state cannot be established, its immutable records do not join, or it is awaiting reconciliation, so a seat is never inferred free.
Derive a delegated Worker's identity from the immutable WorkerRunRef and admission receipt rather than from anything the Worker produced, so a contribution can never name its own author.

Parse one run's contribution draft only from the exact stdout bytes the Host persisted for that run, through a versioned provider-output adapter, and refuse a caller-supplied draft by having no parameter that accepts one.

Derive every contributed signal and handoff identity from the WorkerRunRef and the entry index and every commit identity from the run reference alone, so a retried collection converges instead of appending duplicates.

Publish candidates immutably first and one contribution commit last as the sole visibility boundary, so a projection reads only committed contributions and an interrupted transaction leaves nothing partially visible.
Treat an unusable Worker output as a typed rejection that still persists the ordinary WorkerResult, never as a synthesised empty contribution or an appearance of success.

Separate knowledge succession from execution authority by deriving a bound_task execution context from the persisted TaskFreeze receipt on publish and re-deriving and comparing it on read, and by granting a successor a write path only through the existing release, takeover and acquire lifecycle.

Read collaboration.mode and every mutable collaboration record source twice inside one overlapping collection window, fail closed when mode is unreadable, and derive snapshot_consistency from what the two reads observed, since the store reader is the only layer that can tell a torn read from a still one.
Fail the collection closed when the signal set itself is unreadable, and mark the snapshot degraded when an additive source is, so a partial view is never served as a complete one.
Project existing EngineerOfferV1 records and their offer_revision verbatim into the Work Exchange snapshot, reinterpreting neither readiness nor revision.
Withhold any bound_task execution context whose read-time proof does not hold, and count the omission, rather than publishing an unproven Claim beside a flag.

Build the bounded context packet only from a stable collection, bind its source snapshot, estimator version, truncation evidence and canonical render digest, and compose the rendering into the delegated run's goal inside the untrusted coordination markers.

Record which collaboration packet and rendering entered which run as an additive run-context binding that bumps no delegation protocol, and refuse dispatch when that binding is missing, dangling, or describes a goal other than the one being dispatched.

Decide whether one dispatch is a collaboration dispatch from Host-owned state alone, treating a persisted binding or an untrusted coordination marker in the envelope goal as equally sufficient, so a run that carries injected context but never recorded a binding cannot skip the fence by omitting the record the fence checks.

Serve one bounded Module Engineer surface for both the command family and the MCP tool set, exposing no arbitrary file write, generic shell, task acquire or release, publication, acceptance or merge verb.
Accept no actor, publish destination or recorded time from a caller on that surface, refusing an undeclared key at the boundary rather than dropping it, so an identity claim has nowhere to land.

Serve collaboration reads while collaboration.mode is off and report the mode on every payload, while every mutation fails closed, so the flag stays observable through the surface an operator would use to observe it.

Mark every payload that carries agent-authored text as untrusted coordination context, and pass the canonical untrusted rendering through verbatim rather than re-emitting its markers from a second producer.
